name: Speedtest Tracker
description: Self-hosted internet speed tracking app that runs scheduled Ookla speedtests and displays historical results.

env.label: App URL
env.description: Public URL used to access Speedtest Tracker (e.g. https://speedtest.example.com)

env.label: User ID
env.description: UID for file permission mapping (run 'id -u' to find yours)

env.label: Group ID
env.description: GID for file permission mapping (run 'id -g' to find yours)

env.label: Timezone
env.description: Timezone in tz database format (e.g., America/New_York)

env.label: Speedtest Schedule
env.description: Cron expression for scheduled speedtests (e.g., '0 */6 * * *' for every 6 hours)

env.label: Display Timezone
env.description: Timezone used for displaying results in the UI
